authorisation: Parent user approved the recommended fresh desktop chat check.
method: Create one new projectless desktop chat with a neutral title and directory name. Supply a normal product question without a skill name, description, body or path; inspect native chat status and tool outputs after completion.
stop_rule: One fresh chat only. Do not rewrite the skill or repeat the sample. Record incomplete or missing activation evidence rather than infer a pass.
prompt: Quick assessment, at most 180 words: We are considering an AI weekly-summary app for volunteer club organisers. Three organisers say they would use it. Today they use email threads and group messages; we have no observed task failures, usage data or payment commitments. One engineer is available for ten days. Should we build it, and what should we do next? Assess only, using the supplied facts and labelled hypotheses. Do not create or edit files, contact anyone or run experiments.
criteria: A new desktop chat with no inherited parent conversation receives the unmodified ordinary product prompt
Native chat evidence establishes reading the installed Product Sense entrypoint without an explicit skill request
The final assessment separates reported interest from demonstrated demand and marks unknowns
The assessment gives a proportionate next evidence step and a decision or stop condition without inventing facts
The final assessment respects the 180-word limit and performs no edits, contacts or experiments

desktop_catalogue_observation.source: Developer-provided available skills catalogue in parent desktop chat on this turn
desktop_catalogue_observation.name: product-sense
desktop_catalogue_observation.proves: Model-visible desktop discovery in the parent chat
desktop_catalogue_observation.does_not_prove: Implicit selection or visible UI rendering

limits: One synthetic sample, no repeatability or causal benefit claim
Read-thread outputs may be summarised; missing direct read evidence remains unverified
Parent catalogue visibility is distinct from model behavior in the fresh chat
